# GraspGenModels (not in git)

Weights and checkpoints live here (multi‑GB). Install per upstream GraspGen instructions (e.g. clone the NVIDIA `GraspGenModels` repo, NGC, or your lab mirror) so you have `checkpoints/` under this directory.

This file is tracked so the empty tree has a pointer; everything else under `GraspGenModels/` is listed in the repo root `.gitignore`.
